name: thewatch
description: The Watch San Diego: cybersecurity events calendar and weekly email by Better Security

scripts.dev: wrangler pages dev public --d1 DB=thewatch --binding DEV_MODE=1 --port 8788
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/seed.mjs > scripts/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute thewatch --local --file scripts/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/seed.mjs > scripts/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute thewatch --remote --file scripts/seed.sql
